basic_info.description: Rare opportunity for investors, developers, and owner-occupiers in Russian Hill, one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. This is a corner building featuring 3 vacant units with soaring ceilings, crown molding, original fireplaces, hardwood floors, lots of windows for ample natural light. All 3 units with 4,920 sq ft total include 3-4 bed 1 bath each with in-unit washer/dryer hookups in decent conditions. The accessible roof space offers panoramic views and potential for a roof deck, adding significant value. Just one block from the bustling Polk Corridor and close to North Beach & Chinatown, the property provides easy access to top restaurants, shops, and entertainment. Its prime location, historic charm, development potential and TIC opportunity make it ideal for those seeking a lucrative investment, a renovation project, or a dream home in a vibrant community.
